options.gamemode.title: gamemode Settings
options.gamemode.mode.disabled.descripti: Client game modes are turned off everywhere, and the client always uses the server's game mode.
options.gamemode.mode.oneconfig.descript: The settings are managed in OneConfig. There, client game modes are off until you turn them on with the mod's toggle, and then apply in singleplayer and on every server; use OneConfig profiles to change them for a server. The settings below show what OneConfig applies and cannot be changed here.
options.gamemode.mode.oneconfig.missing: OneConfig mode is selected, but OneConfig is not installed, so the settings below apply.
options.gamemode.switcher_key.descriptio: Whether the Client Game Mode Switcher key (F3 + F5 by default) opens the client game mode switcher. When off, the mod ignores the key, and F3 + F5 works as in vanilla.
options.gamemode.follow_server_changes.d: When the server changes your game mode, the client game mode ends and you use the server's new game mode. When off, the client game mode stays. Respawning or changing dimension in the same game mode never ends it.
options.gamemode.multiplayer_mode.disabl: Never allows client game modes on multiplayer servers.
options.gamemode.multiplayer_mode.whitel: Allows client game modes only on servers in the server list.
options.gamemode.multiplayer_mode.blackl: Allows client game modes on all servers except those in the server list.
options.gamemode.edit_servers.descriptio: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.gamemode: Changes your game mode on the client without asking the server. The server keeps your real game mode.
